name: flow-chart
title: Flow chart
description: A flow (Sankey) diagram: node bars in columns joined by ribbons whose thickness is proportional to the flow they carry. Bars take soft tints from a built-in palette (overridable per node or disableable to a neutral wash); ribbons color by source, target, or a source-to-target gradient. Four alignments (justify, left, right, center), optional d3-style barycenter iterations that reorder columns to untangle crossings, and horizontal or vertical orientation. It fills the host's box on both axes, lays out any number of stages via longest-path columns, tolerates and reports partial mid-stream data, floats host-supplied hover detail beside the pointer, and makes every ribbon a keyboard-focusable button with hover isolation and multi-selectable links.
